scope: One ordinary source preparation and actual playback. Saved images and execution records do not establish continuous human viewing, artistic contribution, or a score.

metadata.note: Metadata/first-frame decode only. This element is never played.

playbackQuality.note: Read from an unplayed metadata probe; not a measurement of the live canvas presentation.

video.validation: Recorded browser artifact; no external encoding or continuous human viewing.

archive.note: Full raw record losslessly compressed, including repeated snapshots and all event arrays. Local raw file ignored; no fields removed.

memory.note: Nominal RGBA surfaces only; not measured process/GPU/encoder peak memory. One reusable staging canvas, no second frame set.
